program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (corners (list (list 0 0) (list 0 (- w 1)) (list (- h 1) 0) (list (- h 1) (- w 1)))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))])
      (if (any? (lambda (p) (member? p corners)) (obj-cells obj))
          (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) 3)
          out))))
